thread:
support_julie: FYI incoming escalation from AcmeSearch — rerank p95 jumped to ~2.1s, lots of 5xx/504s since 10:12 UTC. Customer reports large candidate arrays per request (several thousand). They see retries and app-side timeouts. Can someone triage?

customer_bob: Confirmed. We're running a nightly scoring job that batched candidates into single rerank calls — candidate_count peaked ~10k, body ~30MB. QPS ~150 during the window. We started seeing 504s then client retries which made it worse.

eng_oncall_miguel: Thanks. Can you drop a sample payload and exact timestamps? Which model/endpoint? Any special headers (x-org, x-project)?

support_julie: Model: rerank-v1, endpoint: /v1/rerank, using org-key acme-prod. Sample payload (sanitized) available in the ticket. First observed at 2026-03-16T10:12:14Z.

runtime_elena: Quick check of gateway & worker logs shows CPU and run-queue spikes on the rerank worker pool correlated to requests with candidate_count > ~2500. Batching logic aggregated many client requests into very large internal batches, blowing past our expected token/headroom calcs. KV-cache metrics show heavy eviction churn — looks like cache thrash due to huge sequence states.

infra_ken: Also seeing many client-side retries (exponential backoff not tuned). Gateway queue length hit the max and we started returning 502/504 upstream. Circuit breaker didn't trip fast enough because thresholds were high for this tier.

eng_oncall_miguel: Triage plan: 1) Short-term mitigation: add per-org ingress throttle for acme-prod + server-side candidate_count cap at 2000 (reject with 413 or 429) to stop the herd. 2) Medium: add early validation in gateway to reject >8MB payloads immediately. 3) Longer: per-client batching buckets so one noisy tenant can't steal headroom. Agree?

support_julie: I've messaged the customer asking them to limit candidate_count <= 2000 for now and pause heavy jobs. They prefer auto-truncate if possible (so their jobs don't fail).

runtime_elena: We can add a soft-truncate feature that drops candidates after 2k and returns a warning header, but that risks changing result semantics. Alternative: return 429 with Retry-After and include recommended max.

infra_ken: Practical immediate steps I can deploy: lower circuit-breaker trigger for rerank pool to 70% CPU, increase reserved instances for rerank by +2 in the cluster, and enable a short-lived ingress rate-limit for acme-prod. I'll start the config changes.

eng_oncall_miguel: Repro steps I'm using (staging): create big.json with candidates=10k, then run: 

```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @big.json &
done
```
Run at ~50 concurrent loops for 5m and watch p95 and worker queue size. Observed timeouts start ~90s into sustained high QPS.

deploy-bot: Started deploy: gateway early-validation check to staging (deploy id deploy-7890).

infra_ken: Deployed the temporary ingress throttle for acme-prod and bumped reserved capacity. Lowered circuit-breaker threshold. Monitoring now.

customer_bob: Thanks — we'll throttle our job and run smaller batches. Can you share the recommended repro script and sample big.json?

support_julie: Sent repro script and sample big.json to the customer's S3 link. Assigned this thread to @runtime_elena and @infra_ken for follow-up and a post-incident doc. Will update the customer once stable. :thumbsup: 

eng_oncall_miguel: Follow-ups: schedule an infra change to implement per-customer batching buckets, add a hard payload size check (413), and add a safe auto-truncate/soft-fail option behind a feature flag. I'll open tickets.

runtime_elena: Also adding an eval to our optimize tooling to warn customers whose candidate distributions will cause headroom exhaustion.

support_julie: Closing loop with customer once we see p95 back to normal for 30m.

customer_bob: Appreciated — pausing heavy runs now. :pray:
